title: Kokushkin Bridge
visualBrief: Shallow green panel girder with eight alternating circles and lozenges, cast brackets, wreath railings, raised walks, granite abutments and the photographed navigation plaque and diamond. The short tapered landings follow the PMTiles carriageway and quay walks. The deck meets the native lanes at 20.504 m and the Griboyedov Canal uses a 16.924 m visualization stage.

references.author: Alex Florstein Fedorov
references.use: Inspected full canal-side crossing: shallow green panel girder, eight alternating circle/lozenge panels and brackets, wreath railings, granite end blocks/flared cheeks, permanent clearance plaque and white diamond. No pixels imported.

references.author: Alexei Kouprianov
references.use: Inspected close ironwork: seven thin bars, bottom rings, upper small rings/swags/spikes, central laurel wreath and rosette with cross arms, tall square post with inset diamond. Older pale paint is not copied; geometry informs the2016 green appearance.

limitations: Original photo-led static exterior: mapped19.0048m road segment, flared relation5636139/Q2390563 footprint and approximate15m clear span/13.1m deck width. The map rectangle axis was corrected to the actual road. Metal panel count/details and granite sections are ordinary-photo reconstruction controls, not a measured engineering survey.
Three existing shared256px granite, plain-concrete and painted-metal graphs; all geometry authored, no photo pixels or downloaded mesh.

The 2016 green paint and geometric ironwork are the selected photo appearance; the2006 close ironwork photo has older pale paint. No present-day paint survey or engineering/navigation clearance claim.
The local road grade and canal stage use the retained standard PMTiles and Terrarium setting. The landings and detailed ironwork are visualization approximations.

The source is a full static bridge exterior reconstruction with approximate clear-span/skew, width, granite sections, ornamental leaf counts and navigation marker shapes. The fixed2.6 plaque reproduces a photograph, not an operational clearance promise. Neighboring historic buildings, temporary street signs and independent streetlamps remain outside the asset scope. Physical-device timings are unmeasured.
